description: This Java class, XmlWidgetConditionVisitor, generates XML representations for widget model conditions in the OFBiz framework. It implements visitor pattern methods for various condition types, producing corresponding XML elements.

classes.name: XmlWidgetConditionVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class that converts widget condition objects into XML format.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Methods implementing visitor pattern to handle different condition types and generate corresponding XML elements.

methods.name: visitSubConditions
methods.description: Helper method to visit and process collections of sub-conditions.
